landing.hero.title: The right person is already in your network.
landing.hero.subtitle: Tell Ment what you're working through. See students and alumni with relevant experience, understand why they match, and ask for a short conversation.
landing.preview.query: I'm looking to speak with a professional in Private Equity.
landing.preview.intro: Two people in your network could help.
landing.preview.reason: Here's exactly why they match your question.
landing.preview.privacy: Your organization's network settings determine who can discover profiles.
landing.problem.source: Ment survey of students and alumni, 2026.
landing.problem.line1: {value} of students and recent graduates reach out to alumni through LinkedIn.
landing.problem.line2: {value} say they hear back only sometimes, or never.
landing.problem.line3: Yet {value} of alumni would answer a short, specific question from someone in their own community.
landing.problem.close: The goodwill is already there. What's missing is a channel that reaches it.
landing.how.title: From a question to a conversation
landing.how.step1Description: A private equity interview, moving to a new city, choosing a course. Write it the way you would say it.
landing.how.step2Description: Compare relevant experience, shared background, location, language, and availability.
landing.how.step3Description: Choose someone, edit the note, and find a time that works for both of you.
landing.audiences.title: Who it's for
landing.audiences.students.title: Students and recent graduates
landing.audiences.students.body: Quick access to people who have already done what you're about to do, with a clear reason why each one fits.
landing.audiences.alumni.title: Alumni
landing.audiences.alumni.body: A low-effort way to help your own community, on your terms. Pause at any time and choose how often you can be asked.
landing.audiences.schools.title: Universities
landing.audiences.schools.body: A channel the school owns, with live aggregate reports on activity and on the skills students ask for most. No individual is ever shown.
landing.control.title: AI suggests. People decide.
landing.control.body: Ment reads what you ask and suggests people, with the reason each one fits. You choose who to contact, edit the note and send it yourself.
landing.control.point1: Names are never sent to the AI.
landing.control.point2: Anyone can switch the AI off, or download or delete their data.
landing.control.point3: Universities see activity in aggregate, never individuals.
landing.control.demo.caption: The alumni side
landing.control.demo.paused: Paused. You won't appear in suggestions.
landing.control.demo.hint: Try it. Alumni can change this whenever they like.
landing.finalCta.title: Someone in your network has probably done this before.
landing.finalCta.body: Ment works inside your university's own network. Request access and we'll get back to you.
